variable_coverage.construction: ROA_(t+1)=OPINC_(t+1)/[(TA_t+TA_(t+1))/2]; use the source-defined operating income after depreciation and amortization and average total assets. The numerator is one fiscal year ahead of the 1964–1993 regression anchor.

GrLTNOA_t=[(NOA_t−NOA_(t−1))/[(TA_(t−1)+TA_t)/2]]−ACC_t; NOA uses the source’s listed operating asset/liability components and ACC is the source-defined working-capital-change measure less current depreciation/amortization.

ACC_t=[ΔAR_t+ΔINV_t+ΔOTHERCA_t−ΔAP_t−ΔOTHERCL_t−DEPAMORT_t]/[(TA_(t−1)+TA_t)/2], preserving the paper’s explicit exclusion of tax payable/deferred taxes and its note about possible interest accruals in OTHERCL.

design_coverage.reason: No cluster dimension is reported. The source reports t-statistics from the distribution of annual parameter estimates; the within-year estimator and any per-fit correction are not named.

Retain 30 separate annual cross-sectional Equation (2) fits, then report average coefficients and t-statistics from the annual estimates. The within-year regression estimator is not identified in the source.
